decisive_items: duodenal diverticula, wall thickening with mesenteric edema approximately 25 cm beyond the ligament of Treitz, and mesenteric lymphadenopathy with luminal patency
response.rationale: Imaging directly shows duodenal diverticula with wall thickening and mesenteric edema, and follow-up CT shows resolution of inflammatory changes, strongly supporting diverticulitis. IBD is less supported by absent GI history and normal LFTs; SBO is contradicted by luminal patency.

rejected.why: Only family history of ulcerative colitis and mesenteric lymphadenopathy; no personal GI history, normal LFTs, and imaging points to diverticular inflammation rather than IBD.
Symptoms overlap but imaging shows luminal patency and diverticular inflammation, not obstruction; no evidence of mechanical blockage.
